penalty_policy.background: feedback only; absence and extra content are never penalised or credited
penalty_policy.completeness_penalty_eligible: false => tiers are an unreviewed draft or flagged ambiguous: essential items may be reported as missing but must not reduce the score automatically
penalty_policy.essential: may reduce completeness if not demonstrated (state not_stated); an unverified essential concept lowers confidence, never correctness
penalty_policy.essential_groups: at least min_required members must be demonstrated; any valid member counts; extra valid members are never required
penalty_policy.label_concepts: restate the question topic; satisfied by the essentials; never graded separately
penalty_policy.supporting: may add credit or feedback only; absence is never penalised
penalty_policy.unverified: no credit, no penalty, lower confidence; never treated as incorrect
